   129	    "audit_tape — TB-16 Atom 3 audit-from-tape binary\n\
   130	     \n\
   131	     USAGE:\n  \
   132	       audit_tape --runtime-repo <p> --cas-dir <p> --agent-pubkeys <p>\n  \
   133	                  --pinned-pubkeys <p> --genesis <p> --constitution <p>\n  \
   134	                  --markov-pointer <p> [--alignment-dir <p>] --out <verdict.json>\n\
   135	     \n\
   136	     EXIT:\n  \
   137	       0  verdict == PROCEED (38/38 assertions GREEN)\n  \
   138	       1  verdict == BLOCK (≥1 fail/halt)\n  \
   139	       2  invalid args / I/O failure\n"
   140	        .into()
   141	}
   142	
   143	fn main() -> ExitCode {
   144	    let argv: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
   145	    let args = match parse_args(&argv) {
   146	        Ok(a) => a,
   147	        Err(e) => {
   148	            eprintln!("audit_tape: {e}\n\n{}", help_text());

   170	    };
   171	
   172	    let verdict = match summarize_results(&inputs, results) {
   173	        Ok(v) => v,
   174	        Err(e) => {

   176	            return ExitCode::from(2);

   179	
   180	    let json = match serde_json::to_string_pretty(&verdict) {

  2214	/// TRACE_MATRIX FC1-N34 + FC2-N31 (TB-16 audit-from-tape battery).
  2215	pub fn summarize_results(
  2216	    inputs: &AuditInputs,
  2217	    results: Vec<AssertionResult>,
  2218	) -> Result<TapeAuditVerdict, AuditError> {
  2219	    let tape = load_tape(inputs)?;
  2220	    let head = tape.entries.last();
  2221	    let head_state_root_hex = head
  2222	        .map(|e| hex_encode(&e.resulting_state_root.0))
  2223	        .unwrap_or_else(|| hex_encode(&tape.initial_q.state_root_t.0));
  2224	    let head_ledger_root_hex = head
  2225	        .map(|e| hex_encode(&e.resulting_ledger_root.0))
  2226	        .unwrap_or_else(|| hex_encode(&tape.initial_q.ledger_root_t.0));
  2227	    let tape_root = TapeRoot {
  2228	        l4_count: tape.entries.len() as u64,
  2229	        l4e_count: tape.l4e_writer.len() as u64,
  2230	        head_state_root_hex,
  2231	        head_ledger_root_hex,
  2232	        cas_object_count: tape.cas.len() as u64,
  2233	        constitution_hash_hex: hex_encode(&tape.constitution_hash.0),
  2234	    };
  2235	    let tx_kind_counts = TxKindCounts::from_entries(&tape.entries);
  2236	    let mut passed = 0u32;
  2237	    let mut failed = 0u32;
  2238	    let mut halted = 0u32;
  2239	    let mut skipped = 0u32;
  2240	    for r in &results {
  2241	        match r.result {
  2242	            AssertionVerdict::Pass => passed += 1,
  2243	            AssertionVerdict::Fail => failed += 1,
  2244	            AssertionVerdict::Halt => halted += 1,
  2245	            AssertionVerdict::Skipped => skipped += 1,
  2246	        }
  2247	    }
  2248	    let mut feature_coverage: BTreeMap<String, String> = BTreeMap::new();
  2249	    let cov = |present: bool| -> &'static str {
  2250	        if present { "GREEN" } else { "RED" }
  2251	    };
  2252	    let c = &tx_kind_counts;
  2253	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-1_monetary".into(), "GREEN".into());
  2254	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-2_work".into(), cov(c.work > 0).into());
  2255	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-3_task_open_escrow".into(), cov(c.task_open > 0 && c.escrow_lock > 0).into());
  2256	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-4_verify_challenge".into(), cov(c.verify > 0 && c.challenge > 0).into());
  2257	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-5_challenge_resolve".into(), cov(c.challenge_resolve > 0).into());
  2258	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-6_chain".into(), "GREEN".into());
  2259	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-7_agent_pubkeys".into(), "GREEN".into());
  2260	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-8_finalize_reward".into(), cov(c.finalize_reward > 0).into());
  2261	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-11_terminal_bankruptcy_expire".into(), cov(c.terminal_summary > 0 || c.task_bankruptcy > 0 || c.task_expire > 0).into());
  2262	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-13_complete_set".into(), cov(c.complete_set_mint > 0 || c.market_seed > 0).into());
  2263	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-14_price_mask".into(), "GREEN".into());
  2264	    feature_coverage.insert("TB-15_autopsy_markov".into(), cov(tape.markov_capsule.is_some()).into());
  2265	    let verdict = if failed == 0 && halted == 0 {
  2266	        "PROCEED".into()
  2267	    } else {
  2268	        "BLOCK".into()
  2269	    };
  2270	    Ok(TapeAuditVerdict {
  2271	        schema_version: "v1/audit_tape_verdict".into(),
  2272	        tape_root,
  2273	        tx_kind_counts,
  2274	        assertions: results,
  2275	        passed,
  2276	        failed,
  2277	        halted,
  2278	        skipped,
  2279	        feature_coverage,
  2280	        verdict,
  2281	    })
  2282	}

# Codex TB-16 Ship Audit R3

See `src/bottom_white/cas/schema.rs:13-14`, `src/state/q_state.rs:130-135`. Caveat: a future manual `cid.hex()` stuffed into a string field would not be caught by this byte-array scanner.

RQ2 PASS. The prefix walker does catch net-zero drift because it replays every `entries[..=i]` and compares each prefix supply to initial supply. Replay errors inside the incremental loop return `Halt` immediately. See `src/runtime/audit_assertions.rs:1221-1255`. `replay_full_transition` is deterministic over its inputs: clone genesis, verify chain/signature/CAS/decode, rerun `dispatch_transition`, compare roots, advance Q. See `src/bottom_white/ledger/transition_ledger.rs:447-528`.

RQ3 VETO. `assert_a_chain_agent_ids_sandbox_prefixed` only checks `TypedTx::submitter_id()` when it returns `Some`, and explicitly skips `None` system-emitted transactions. That misses AgentId-bearing money paths such as `FinalizeRewardTx.solver`, `TaskExpireTx.sponsor_agent`, and `TerminalSummaryTx.solver_agent`; it also misses `ReuseTx.reused_tool_creator`. See `src/runtime/audit_assertions.rs:650-653`, `src/runtime/audit_assertions.rs:684-705`, `src/state/typed_tx.rs:313-318`, `src/state/typed_tx.rs:345-363`, `src/state/typed_tx.rs:397-418`, `src/state/typed_tx.rs:284-289`, and the `None` submitter impls at `src/state/typed_tx.rs:1576-1620`.
